author: ojiudezue
title: v5.96.0 shipped: Egress identity: BLE entry crossing producer (naming finally fires)
summary: Egress identity: BLE entry crossing producer (naming finally fires)
why: Egress person_id attached on 1 of 7314 crossings because the BLE leg keyed off person.state (a last_updated race across all a person's trackers, incl stationary Macs) behind a Bermuda-only gate that dropped every GPS-sourced departure. Re-sourcing directly to bluetooth_le device_trackers escapes the race and the provenance drop; D0 measured BLE as the clean signal with the home edge leading the crossing ~105s, so entry resolves in the existing window. Exit is genuinely harder (not_home edge lags ~369s) and is deferred to a backfill cycle.
implications: Shipped EGRESS-BLE-PROVENANCE-GATE-DROPS-DEPARTURES-1 at v5.96.0; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.96.0.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Post-restart: the next real resident arrival writes a person_entry_exit_events row with the correct person_id; produced/attached observability counters move off zero; a bluetooth_le tracker blipping unavailable does not drop its subscription

refs.release_notes: Re-architected the egress crossing producer to subscribe directly to residents' bluetooth_le device_trackers instead of the racy person.state aggregate, so arrivals attach a person_id for the first time (was 1/7314). Entry-only v1; exit deferred to a backfill cycle. Sticky BLE classification through unavailable, boot-race self-heal, per-slug single-use, cross-resident abstain guard, discriminating observability. Tier-3: 3 plan-reviews + 3 framing-disjoint build reviews + consolidated fix-up + orchestrator mutation-verify.
